messages:
emily.partnerships: CloudWay Systems uploaded their co-branded asset pack for the cloud marketplace tile + a one-page solution brief. Quick QA please: logo lockup, dark-mode variant, and the one-line customer highlight. Can we review by Tue 2pm PT?

noah.design: Taking a look. Their SVG is fine but the mark has a thin outline that disappears at small sizes. I made a mono lockup and a flattened SVG in Figma: https://figma.com/file/cloudway/cloudway-redwood-lockups. Recommend mono on dark.

isla.marketing: Draft hero headline: "Redwood + CloudWay: deploy inference faster." I'll post two tighter headline options and a 20-word marketplace summary.

sam.prod: They claim "30% lower per-token cost" — tests used aggressive caching. Suggest wording: "up to 30% lower per-token cost on cache-optimized workloads" and add a short caption with test config: `HW: 8xA100, model=redwood-small, batch=8, cache=enabled`. Also request a p95 latency metric for the tile.

erin.legal: Legal reminders: need signed co-brand license and explicit written consent for customer quote. Marketplace requires a hedging line under results: "Performance results based on specific tests; results may vary." I'll send the addendum template to CloudWay legal.

assets-bot: Reminder: Marketplace checklist incomplete: missing signed license, contrast check, and exported SVGs at 3 sizes. See: https://internal/docs/marketplace-checklist. Deadline 48h.

noah.design: Uploaded export zip (SVG, PNG @2x, mono) to thread and added small-size guidance in Figma.

isla.marketing: Posted two headline variants: A) "Cut inference cost with Redwood + CloudWay" B) "Deploy low-latency inference quickly." Also posted a 20-word meta summary for marketplace SEO.

sam.prod: I'll pull the p95 numbers and attach a short reproducibility note this afternoon.

erin.legal: Sent co-brand request; awaiting CloudWay legal sign-off. Will update here.

emily.partnerships: Plan: noah finalize exports, erin secure signatures, sam provide p95 + caption, isla finalize copy. Target upload Thu morning if approvals come back. /remind me Wed 9am to follow up. Thanks all.
